**Observation Log:**

[SESSION_DATE] 2023/07/29 (Sat) 10:27  
[USER] User is trying to plan out meals for the week.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy lunch ideas that can be prepped in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Meal prep is a great way to save time and ensure healthy meals throughout the week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested healthy lunch ideas include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Salads:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grilled Chicken Salad: Grill chicken breast, prep mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and carrots. Add nuts or seeds and a protein-rich topping like feta cheese or chickpeas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Quinoa Salad: Cook quinoa and mix with roasted vegetables like sweet potatoes, Brussels sprouts, and chickpeas. Add a citrus vinaigrette dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lentil Salad: Cook lentils and mix with diced veggies like onions, bell peppers, and carrots. Add a simple vinaigrette dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Sandwiches:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Turkey and Avocado Wrap: Prep sliced turkey breast, avocado, lettuce, and tomato. Store in separate containers and assemble in the morning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Veggie Delight: Prep a variety of veggies like cucumber, bell peppers, sprouts, and hummus. Assemble the sandwich in the morning with whole-grain bread or a wrap.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Soups:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lentil Soup: Cook a big batch and portion it out in individual containers. Add a side of whole-grain bread or crackers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Veggie Soup: Prep a variety of veggies like carrots, zucchini, and tomatoes. Blend with broth and store in individual containers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Rice Bowls:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chicken and Veggie Bowl: Grill chicken breast and prep roasted veggies like broccoli, carrots, and sweet potatoes. Serve over brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Black Bean and Corn Bowl: Cook black beans and prep diced veggies like bell peppers, onions, and corn. Serve over brown rice with feta cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Mini Meals:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mason Jar Meals: Prep individual portions of rice, beans, and veggies in mason jars. Add a protein source like chicken, tuna, or tofu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Fruit and Cheese Cups: Prep cups with fresh fruit like berries,
